title: Define "fails" and add the optional Misato fallback to cloud
goal: A measurable failure rule and an off-by-default fallback, Misato only
acceptance: The rule is written in the code and the record: the local answer fails when its structured plan is invalid after one repair retry, a required tool call is rejected by its schema, the call times out, or a pack-defined check on that request type fails; never a judgement of quality
Fallback only to the cloud model the owner set for Misato, only when F-156 allows the data category and the monthly limit has room; local-only input never falls back; Casper never involved
Tests first for each failure kind, for refusal when budget or privacy forbids, and a join test across router, budget and privacy
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
